skills.description: Execute S3 pilots and S4 native materialization in the isolated environment, then require an independent S5 reopen.
Independently inspect and validate bounded medical-research artifacts before batch continuation or delivery.
Use host-authorized data dictionaries, aggregate cohorts, and registered analyses with privacy-preserving, verifiable research controls.
Conduct a bounded host-simulated clinical dialogue using focused questions, examinations, and images without claiming real patient care.
Use host-authorized longitudinal EHR quality and forecast tools with aggregate, provenance-bound outputs.
Build a traceable medical-research evidence summary from host-approved bounded sources, consultations, and analyses.
Request one host-authorized stronger-model research consultation through an opaque bounded request and integrate it as fallible evidence.
Use host-bound FHIR research tools for bounded reads, searches, draft writes, and authorized commits with schema and privacy checks.
Conduct a bounded simulated clinical-research interaction using host-provided dialogue, exam, image, and evidence tools.
Plan and complete a bounded multi-stage medical-research task with checkpointed artifacts, pilots, validation, and final delivery.
Retrieve bounded evidence only from host-approved, versioned medical-research sources and preserve traceable limitations.
Apply host-validated clinical research calculators and evidence-synthesis frameworks with explicit inputs, uncertainty, and verification.
Integrate bounded medical-research evidence, analyses, and intermediate artifacts into a traceable draft for validation.
Validate and deliver bounded medical-research artifacts with independent checks rather than treating an execution success as completion.
Inspect a host-bound medical image through a bounded visual tool and record observations without inventing image findings.
Review bounded host-approved medication-safety evidence for a research question without converting it into prescribing advice.
Review host-bound pathology regions and imaging volumes through bounded identifiers and verification artifacts.
Maintain declared consent, privacy, de-identification, and analysis-governance boundaries throughout a medical-research workflow.
Draft a bounded research protocol artifact from approved evidence, analysis plans, and host-provided templates.
Produce a host-declared structured research artifact and submit it only after schema, completeness, and privacy validation.
Select and use only host-admitted native tools for bounded medical-research work instead of treating code execution as a universal capability.
Search a host-approved clinical-trial snapshot with bounded eligibility, intervention, outcome, or recruiting intent.
